description:
Goal
Cut materialization/artifact consumers off the trash-prefixed recursive layout authority and make them read the already-proven TransportPlan facts from fz-hwn.20.

Required change
Artifact/materialization handoffs carry ShapeId/TransportPosition references and plan revisions, not copied recursive layouts. Executable input, return, resume, entry-capture, body-value, call-arg, and continuation-payload facts are read from TransportPlan. RuntimeDemand::Ignore has already become Shape::Nothing during plan construction; this ticket must not recreate Ignore/Omitted layout variants downstream.

No bridge rule
Do not derive TransportPlan from TrashRuntimeValueLayout and do not derive TrashRuntimeValueLayout from TransportPlan. Do not keep a dual-authority committed path. If a seam cannot compile atomically without both authorities, it is one seam and must be changed as one commit.

Removal target
TrashRuntimeValueLayout, TrashRuntimeInputLayout, the trash-prefixed old RuntimeLane, abi_reprs()/lane_tys() walks on recursive layout, runtime_value_layout_from_demand, runtime_input_layout_from_demand, local_callable_layout as a layout builder, internal return/resume/capture fields that carry old layout trees, and any artifact helper that still walks old shape structure to produce another shape.

Checks
All fz-hwn.19.1 tests stay green; cargo check --all-targets; rg confirms old layout authority is gone from artifact/materialization consumers outside historical docs or later-ticket inventories.
title: Transport cutover: replace recursive layout consumers with TransportPlan facts
